out_of_bounds.action: head_ref stands near the corner flag, pointing firmly down the touchline to signal an out-of-bounds call.
out_of_bounds.reaction: The soccer ball rests stationary right on the boundary line near the corner, while young players in home and away kits watch from the background.

goal_kick.action: asst_ref raises flag stands near the corner flag, pointing firmly down the touchline to signal an out-of-bounds call.
goal_kick.reaction: The soccer ball rests stationary right on the boundary line near the corner, while young players in home and away kits watch from the background.
goal_kick.action: asst_ref stands along the touchline outside the field, holding an official checkered flag and pointing it clearly and horizontally straight out toward the goal area to signal a goal kick after the attacking team put the ball over the end line.
goal_kick.reaction: The soccer ball rests beyond the goal line near the goal area, and the main referee and players look on from the pitch.
